data.rationale: The proposal matches the core procedure (Sail To, Sail From, Dates, Search Cruises) in the right order with the right parameters, but it ends with guest or filter refinement and closing a popover instead of clicking the favorite heart on a result, and it adds a vague "filters" parameter. Because of that, the final goal is missed, though a browser automation could still be built for the search part.
